# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Age:** 16  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c36 P37](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c34 P15](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Anne of Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c33 P48](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0048)</sub>; Cordelia

## Appearance

Anne is a tall young woman who carries herself erectly. She has large, expressive eyes and a pointed chin. She wears her red hair styled in various fashions and dresses neatly.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P37](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0037)_

## Personality

Anne is an imaginative, ambitious, and passionate young woman with a intense capacity for deep friendships. She possesses a poetic, thoughtful nature that thrives on dreams, beauty, and the outdoors. While capable of intense focus and hard work, she is sensitive to judgment and can harbor dramatic emotional reactions to her mistakes or slights. She shows deep loyalty, pride, and gratitude toward her loved ones.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025), [v1 c30 P27](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0027), [v1 c33 P48](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0048), [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c34 P15](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0015), [v1 c34 P16](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0016), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007)_

## History

Anne grew up at Green Gables under the care of Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert, where she pursued her studies at Avonlea School under Miss Stacy. Following a period of intense rivalry with classmate Gilbert Blythe, she prepared for and passed the entrance examinations for Queen's Academy. Upon moving to town for her studies, she was overcome with initial homesickness, which was eased by weekly trips back to Avonlea on Fridays with her schoolmates. Advised by Miss Stacy, Anne elected to take the advanced Second Year course alongside Gilbert Blythe to obtain a First Class teacher's license in one year. During her time at Queen's, she formed a close circle of ambitious friends, including Stella Maynard and Priscilla Grant, and spent spare hours visiting Miss Barry at Beechwood. Throughout her academic year, Anne worked steadily, emerging as one of the top three contenders for the academy medal and a prime candidate for the Avery scholarship.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c30 P28](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0028), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c34 P13](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0013), [v1 c34 P15](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0015), [v1 c35 P0](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0000), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 c35 P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 c35 P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_
